subject: Animation
title: Lotso: The Smiling Tyrant
description: A short lesson to help you apply Lotso: The Smiling Tyrant.

hook.text: Lotso from Toy Story 3 smells like strawberries, hugs everyone, and runs a totalitarian prison for toys.

buildup.text: He controls Sunnyside Daycare with surveillance, enforcers, and psychological manipulation disguised as warmth.

discovery.text: Lotso's backstory reveals he was once loved, then replaced — his cruelty comes from genuine heartbreak.

twist.text: Unlike most villains who are redeemed when shown mercy, Lotso is given a chance to change and refuses it.

climax.text: Lotso proved Pixar could create a villain who is sympathetic in origin but irredeemable in choice.

punchline.text: A strawberry-scented teddy bear became one of cinema's most chilling villains.

quiz.question: What makes Lotso from Toy Story 3 an unusual animated villain?
options: He looks warm and friendly but runs a totalitarian system, and refuses redemption when given the chance
He is the only animated villain who wins
